text:
Sara: Heads-up — planning a recruitment surge for our Summer design-partner + beta cohorts. Want to align on prioritization, intake, and launch criteria. Quick sync?

Mike: Yes please. Do we have target numbers? e.g., 10 DP seats + 50 beta?

Sara: Thinking up to 12 DP slots (high-touch) and ~40 beta seats (low-touch). Open to changing. Main question: how do we pick which customer asks are priority vs nice-to-have?

Ana: Suggest tiered criteria: "must-validate" (hard launch blockers), "should-validate" (important perf/UX tradeoffs), "nice-to-have" (future work). Measure with pass/fail signal sets.

Kevin: From GTM side — prioritize customers who are likely to convert to Dedicated or larger usage. Ask: company size, expected monthly tokens, compliance needs. Incentives matter: credits + 1:1 onboarding works best.

James: For intake, we should collect minimal gating info. Draft snippet below:

```
- Company name
- Use case (100 chars)
- Expected monthly tokens
- Data sensitivity (public/PII/regulated)
- Contact + technical lead
- Timeline for launch
- Success metric (1 KPI)
```

Mike: + add a short checkbox for willingness to run eval workloads with our telemetry on (opt-in). Also ask for sample prompts.

Sara: Good. Also need launch criteria:
- DP: 80% of success KPIs met across 75% of partners, no P0 quality regressions, basic SLA playbook validated.
- Beta: stability for 95th pct latency under target for 2 weeks, regression alerting in place, and one fallback path tested.

Ana: Recommend pre-defined evaluation suite per cohort. We'll create 6 canonical prompts and 12 edge-case prompts. Pass threshold: >=90% acceptance rate on canonical, <10% catastrophic failures on edge cases.

Kevin: Can we stretch the DP window to 8 weeks with a mid-point check? That helps with conversion.

Sara: Yes. Planning 8 weeks for DP, 3 for Beta. Midpoint check at week 4 (DP).

James: Ops note — we need a routing policy for requests that fail our canary model. Proposed fallback: route to best-effort hosted run + flagged for triage. Also ensure token accounting separately.

Mike: Outreach copy idea: short subject line + 3 bullets showing time commitment, incentives, and expected outcomes. Keep it <150 chars.

Sara: + add a calendar of milestone checkpoints (onboarding, week 2 evaluation, midpoint, closeout demo). Who owns the closeout report? @Ana?

Ana: I can own the closeout template and aggregate evaluation results. Will need engineering logs and sample responses.

Kevin: I'll prep incentive language and send to the sales SDR list for targeted outbound.

James: I'll build the intake form in Typeform and wire webhook to the DP Slack channel + Ops spreadsheet. Quick config: send payload to /hooks/dp-intake -> include sample prompts.

Sara: Perfect. Action items:
- James: intake form + webhook (due Tue)
- Ana: eval suite + closeout template (due Thu)
- Kevin: outreach copy + incentive plan (due Wed)
- Mike: outreach creative + checklist for onboarding UX (due Wed)
- Sara: compile launch criteria doc + rollout schedule (due Fri)

eva-bot: Reminder set for 1973000062: "DP intake form review" (scheduled for Tue 09:00).

Mike: :thumbsup: 

Kevin: I'll loop in @nicole from legal about data contracts for DP customers (brief heads-up).

Sara: Thanks team — small follow-up sync Friday 10am to finalize.

James: noted, will post form link in this thread when ready.
